items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Then I had to tell what happened to my friend Lola.

ctx.x: She said, "Well, she's had it." He said, "Oh, for heaven's sake. May I come up?" She said, "Yes," and the baby was still there. The baby was -- you know, he was still there in this incubator, and Jim Wynn came and he never got over that. He never got over seeing this baby in this home-made incubator. And he said to the doctor, because they had the kitchen door closed, he said, "May I come in, please? May I please come in?" And they said, "Yes, yes, come in for just a second." So they let him come in, and he came…

Then this -- let me see. Let me see, now, later I think he must have called -- he called his wife, he called Lola Wynne, who was his wife, and told her, because they didn't live too far from us at that time, so he called his wife and told Lola Wynne to -- he says, "Be sure and go by Nellie's house. Nellie's had her baby." And Lola gave a scream, "What? Had the baby?" So then later she came by.
